source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p42
s: Who is the President of the Imperial Council of Vijayanagara Empire?
x: Vijayanagara Empire had a Council of Ministers to assist the king in administration. The President of this council is the Prime Minister or Sarva Sirah Pradhani, also known as Sabha nayaka, Tantra nayaka and karyakarta.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p42
s: Which one of the prominent cities of Satavahana kingdom in Godavari region?
x: Pratishthana Puram, said to be a capital during the Satavahana period, is located on the banks of the Godavari in Maharashtra. Muski falls under Raichur district of Karnataka, where an Ashoka inscription was found.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p42
s: Which was a prominent import from the West during the Sangama clan?
x: During the Sangama age of Vijayanagara, horses were the main import from the West, along with Persian women, silk cloths and pearls. Kalamkari clothes were the main export.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p42
s: Who presided over the Andhra Mahasabha meeting held at Bellary?
x: The Andhra Mahasabha held at Bellary in 1943 was chaired by Vijayanagara Kumara Raja Sir Vijaya. Kadapa Kotireddy presided over the silver jubilee session at Bezawada in 1937.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p42
s: Who is known as the father of the Andhra movement?
x: As part of the Andhra movement, Konda Venkatappayya wrote a book called Andhrodyamam and was called the father of the Andhra movement.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p42
s: Krishnadevaraya was a contemporary of whom?
x: Mughal Emperor Babur and Sikander Lodi were contemporaries of Krishnadevaraya. Akbar's contemporaries were Tirumala Raya and Venkatapati Raya-II.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p42
s: Who Organized Bipin Chandrapal's Visit to Andhra?
x: Mutnuri Krishna Rao organized Bipin Chandrapal's visit to Andhra during the Vande Mataram movement. Hari Sarvottama Rao was the leader of Home Rule in Andhra.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p42
s: Who translated Gandhi's speech into Telugu at Vijayawada during the Non-Cooperation Movement?
x: Ayyadevara Kaleswara Rao translated Gandhi's speech in Vijayawada during the Non-Cooperation Movement into Telugu.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p42
s: Who was the first Andhra woman who gave up the foreign garments and adopted khaddar wearing during Gandhiji's visit to Andhra state?
x: Maganti Annapoornamma was the first Andhra woman who gave up foreign garments and adopted Khaddar during Gandhi's visit to Andhra. Ponaka Kanakamma established Kasturba Girls School in Nellore.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p42
s: Which one of the following suggests reorganization of states on linguistic basis?
x: The Nehru Report recommended that provinces be created along linguistic lines. The Dhar Commission (1948) later rejected formation of states on the basis of language.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p42
s: What was the first criminal case reported in Andhra during the Vande Mataram movement?
x: The first criminal case reported in Andhra during the Vande Mataram movement was the Kakinada kotlata case of 31 May 1907. It arose when a boy who shouted Vande Mataram at Captain Kemp was beaten up.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p42
s: Find the wrong pairing from the following
o: Rutherford - Special Commissioner appointed for proceedings against Sitarama raju
Endu Padal - A muttadar of pedda valasa
x: Endu Padalu wanted to become a muttadar of Pedda Valasa village but could not.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p42
s: Who was the first ruler to join the system of subsidiary alliance?
x: The Nizam of Hyderabad was the first king to join the subsidiary alliance system in 1798, introduced by Governor General Lord Wellesley.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p43
s: Vedavanam became the center of Salt Satyagraha activities in Madras. Whose house is that?
x: Vedavanam, the house of Tanguturi Prakasam, became the focal point for salt satyagraha activities in Madras.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p43
s: Which local ruler of Mauryan period mentioned in Bhattiprolu inscription?
x: The Bhattiprolu pillar inscription mentions a king named Kubhiraka in the latter half of the 3rd century BC. Administration was carried out with the help of Nigama Sabha and Goshti.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p43
s: Hala 'Gathasaptasati' begins with which prayer?
x: Gathasaptasati, written by Hala in Prakrit, describes the social aspects of the Satavahanas. It starts with the prayer of Shiva.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p43
s: Who was the first Chalukya-Chola king?
x: Rajendra, son of the Chalukya king Rajaraja Narendra, became the first Chalukya-Chola king with the title Kulottunga Chola, as the Chola kingdom had no heirs.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p43
s: Which is not correct regarding the Vijayanagara period?
o: The practice of sati sahagamana prevails.
There is an exchange of dowries.
x: Polygamy, sati, dowry and child marriage were all practiced in the Vijayanagara kingdom.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p43
s: Name of Achyutaraya Sabha Bhavana?
x: Achyutaraya's assembly was called Venkata Vilasa Mandapam; Krishnadevaraya's was Bhuvana Vijayam and Devaraya-II's was Mutyala Shala.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p43
s: Who is popularly known as 'Kavi Samrat' in Telugu literature?
x: Viswanatha Satyanarayana is known as Kavi Samrat in Telugu literature. He received the first Jnanpith award in Telugu for Srimad Ramayana Kalpavrikshamu.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p43
s: Which Andhra citizen participated in the 'Vandemataram' movement along with Bipin Chandrapal who went to many places?
x: Mutnuri Krishna Rao supervised Bipin Chandrapal's visit to Andhra during the Vande Mataram movement, while Harisarvottama Rao took an active part in all matters.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p43
s: The Sanskrit grammar book Katantra Vyakaranam was authored by?
x: Sarvavarma wrote the Sanskrit treatise Katantra Vyakaranam during the time of Kuntala Satakarni, whom he taught Sanskrit. It is the first Sanskrit text in the south.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p43
s: Who conquered Madurai in the south on behalf of the Vijayanagara Empire?
x: In 1371 AD Kumara Kampana, son of Bukkaraya-I, with Saluva Mangaraja and Gopana defeated the Sultan of Madurai and merged it into the Vijayanagara kingdom. Gangadevi describes this in her Madhura Vijayam.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p43
s: What was popularly called the largest administrative division during the Satavahanas period?
x: The largest administrative division of the Satavahanas was the Ahara, administered by an Amatya. Soparahara, Govardhanahara, Mamalahara and Satavahanahara were important Aharas.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p43
s: The Vijayanagara kings are credited with achieving agricultural development by which initiatives?
o: by reducing the tax on cultivated land
by providing market facilities for agricultural produce
by purchasing food grains for their army
x: The kings of Vijayanagara built ponds, embankments and wells for agricultural development; tank construction was considered one of the Sapta Santhanas. Krishnadevaraya built the Nagalapuram tank.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p43
s: Who established Saraswati Gachchas to promote education among common people?
x: Jains established Saraswati Gachchas to propagate education among common people. They were established by Kondakundacharya during the Satavahana period in Andhra.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p43
s: What was the method adopted by the Rampa Rebellion?
o: Acquisition of British arms and using them for war
x: Alluri Sitaramaraju used to inform the police in advance, attack their stations and seize weapons to fight back against them.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p43
s: When did the Vajrayana branch of Buddhism emerge?
x: Vajrayana, a Tantric form of Buddhism, was born in Andhra Desa in the 7th century AD. It was started by Siddha Nagarjuna.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p44
s: Where are the Nava Brahma temples located?
x: The Nava Brahma temples were built by the Badami Chalukyas at Alampur in Jogulamba Gadwal district of Telangana.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p44
s: In which year did Eastern Chalukya rule begin?
x: Kubja Vishnuvardhana established the Eastern Chalukya kingdom in 624 with Vengi as his capital.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p44
s: The area where 'Panchanam varu' or 'professional artisans' emerged as a group?
x: Panchanams emerged as a group in Andhra Desa during the Eastern Chalukya period. The five castes of blacksmith, goldsmith (Kamsali), brazier (Kanchari), carpenter and sculptor are known as Panchanam or Veerapanchanam.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p44
s: Whom did Gautamiputra Satakarni have to face?
x: Gautamiputra Satakarni defeated Nahapana of the Kshaharata clan, a branch of the Sakas, and earned the title Kshaharata Vamsa Niravasesakara.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p44
s: The ruler of Satavahana who married Rudradama's daughter?
x: The Junagadh/Girnar inscription shows Rudradaman married his daughter to Vasishtiputra Sivasri Satakarni.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p44
s: The script in which Satavahana inscriptions were written?
x: The inscriptions of the Satavahanas were written in the Prakrit language in Brahmi script.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p44
s: Which coin was used as currency during the Satavahana period?
x: Coins minted in copper and silver during the Satavahana period were called Karshapanas. Karshapanas combined together made one Suvarna, a gold coin.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p44
s: Son-in-law of Krishnadevaraya?
x: Krishnadevaraya's son-in-law was Aliya Ramaraya, whose actions led to the Battle of Talikota (Rakshasa Tangadi) on 23 January 1565.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p44
s: The place where Krishnadevaraya planted the victory pillar?
x: Krishnadevaraya erected a victory pillar at Potnur near Simhachalam while returning from his eastern campaigns.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p44
s: What profession did 'Balanjalu' take up in Vijayanagara society?
x: Balanjas (Veerabalijas) and Ayyavals ran business in Vijayanagara society. Weavers were called Kaikolas.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p44
s: Author of 'Sahitya Sudha'?
x: Govinda Dikshitulu, minister of Raghunatha Raya, wrote Sahitya Sudha.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p44
s: Who is the author of the book "Hindu Desha Daridryam"?
x: Attili Suryanarayana wrote Hindu Desa Daridryam in support of the Vande Mataram Movement in Andhra.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p44
s: Who established the National College at Madanapalle in 1916?
x: In 1916 Annie Besant established the National College at Madanapalle. J. H. Cousins was its first principal.

source: latestpyqs RRR AP History Previous Papers (b2p4) p44
s: Who led the 'Social Purity' movement?
x: Raghupathi Venkataratnam Naidu, a disciple of Kandukuri Veereshalingam, founded the Social Purity Society in 1891. He worked against the Devadasi system and for upliftment of Harijans.
